items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Beispielhausen, Am Musterwall 7, 31134 Beispielhausen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Assume the letter was handed to the postal service on its printed date, 27.10.2025 (Monday). The Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states the notice is deemed delivered on the fourth day after posting, which matches the current version of §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (amended in 2025 to extend the postal-delivery fiction from three to four days). 27.10.2025 + 4 calendar days = 31.10.2025 (Friday). 31 October is Reformationstag, a statutory public holiday in Niedersachsen, so the fictional delivery date is pushed to the next business day: Saturday 1.11. and Sunday 2.11. are skipped, giving deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) on Monday 03.11.2025. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month objection period begins on the day after Bekanntgabe (04.11.2025) and, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day itself, i.e. 03.12.2025 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or Niedersachsen public holiday, so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 03.12.2025.

items.title: Receive income tax refund (Erstattung)
items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
items.computation: The letter only states the refund of 767,00 € will be paid 'in the next few days' without giving a specific calendar date, so no exact due date can be computed; this is an inbound payment to the taxpayer, not an obligation with a fixed deadline.

warnings: The delivery-fiction and period calculation assume the letter was actually posted on its printed date (27.10.2025); if the actual mailing date differs, the Einspruch deadline (03.12.2025) shifts accordingly.

The 'four days after posting' delivery fiction quoted in the letter matches the version of §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO in force since the 2025 postal-law reform; verify this is still current if advising for a later period.
